爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD034 水谷柚子Mizutani Yuzu-格子裙暴击
我精心换上格子裙，开开心心去找男朋友，盼着他夸我温柔好看。
谁知道他凑近我耳边，低声说不穿裙子更好看。
我瞬间脸颊烧得滚烫，心跳乱作一团，紧张地攥着裙边，压根不敢抬头跟他对视。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD034 Mizutani Yuzu-Plaid Skirt Attack
I carefully changed into my plaid skirt, happily heading to find my boyfriend, hoping he'd compliment me on my gentle and beautiful appearance.
But who knew he'd lean close to my ear and whisper that I looked better without the skirt.
My cheeks instantly burned, my heart pounded, and I nervously clutched the hem of my skirt, not daring to look him in the eye.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
